messages:
ravi: Quick flag: stratus-small int8 onboard canary is producing valid JSON structures that still fail funcall routing due to unexpected top-level wrappers and occasional trailing prose. Opening thread with raw examples.

ela: sample please — are these parse errors or shape mismatches?

ravi: captured stream from 2026-03-22 canary: 
```json
[ {"tool": "fetch_profile", "args": {"user": "u_55"} } ]
```
schema expects a single object, not an array. Router throws RouteTypeMismatch.

ciara: hmm array wrapper again. We saw similar with other quant runs but this one has higher incidence in prompts mentioning "give me the details as a list" even when instructions ask for an object. Possibly LM is optimizing for bracketing tokens under int8.

galen: any tailing prose cases? those are harder because strict parser bails.

ravi: yes, another failing chunk: 
```json
{"tool":"trace_event","args":{"evt":"x"}} - couldn't find metadata for evt x
```
note the hyphen and continuation appended in the same frame (no newline in the stream).

ciara: two classes: (1) array wrapping, (2) appended free-text. For (1) coercion seems low-risk if length==1 and element shape matches. For (2) we can allow trailing suffix in canary only and capture in metadata.

ela: proposal: implement a "token-fence" prompt token for all new onboards (very short sentinel string like <RDW_END>) appended after required JSON. That gives deterministic boundary. Also enable a canary soft-coerce layer: array->object when safe, suffix->accept with logged suffix. Strict header X-RDW-STRICT: true should bypass coercion.

galen: agree. Add gauges: struct.coerce.count, struct.coerce.pct, struct.suffix.accepted.pct, per-model labels. If any model exceeds 1.5% coerced or suffix accepted, signal rollback.

ciara: implementable plan:
- short-term (canary): enable soft coercion + suffix-accept for int8 canaries only. No prompt changes.
- mid-term: require token-fence in onboarding template, update onboarding docs and examples.
- long-term: add token-smoke test in the preflight that dumps tokens and checks for sentinel presence.

ravi: added canary toggle soft_coerce=true and suffix_tolerant=true to canary config. Pushed change and started a 8k sample run.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 6723456840 by ravi: soft_coerce + suffix_tolerant toggles enabled for eng-ml canary :white_check_mark:

ela: also adding a small evaluation harness to classify the failure modes: array-wrapper vs suffix vs true malformed JSON. Will post a breakdown table when done.

ciara: tiny extra: add a heuristic that if the token sequence ends with a punctuation token immediately after the closing brace and the remainder tokens are alpha tokens (explanatory), treat as suffix. This avoids accepting cases where model truly intended extra JSON.

galen: documentation note: update the "structured output" onboarding checklist and the playbook. Liaise with platform SDKs to expose X-RDW-STRICT.

ravi: PR #4722 opened: canary soft-coerce & suffix-tolerant + metrics. cc @release-eng. If our evaluation shows functional success improvement and coerced rates under thresholds, we'll roll to dedicated and then bake it into onboarding defaults.

structbot: alert registered 6723456854 - struct.coerce and struct.suffix metrics live for canary. Monitoring dashboards created.
